marketing_description: The DeWALT DCLE34031B 3x360 Line Laser features a self-leveling operation and green laser technology for enhanced visibility, with a working range of 165 ft with a detector and 130 ft without. This tool has an accuracy of +/-1/8 in at 30 ft and a leveling range of +/- 4 deg. It is powered by a 20 V battery and has an IP rating of IP54.
